question: Should ClawHub accept `claimState`, `officialState`, and `restrictionState` as the official-publisher admin API vocabulary after the derivation bug and proof gap are fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a trust-state contract that downstream clients may depend on, so automation should not decide the permanent vocabulary or whether this should land as runtime API versus spec-only work.

options.title: Accept after fix and proof
options.body: Land the separated state vocabulary only after claim derivation is corrected and redacted runtime/API proof shows the response shape.

options.title: Land spec-only first
options.body: Keep the internal state-boundary spec and defer the admin API field until vocabulary and derivation are settled.

options.title: Decline the new API field
options.body: Keep the existing official-publisher API contract and revisit broader publisher trust-state surfaces separately.

recommendation.title: Accept after fix and proof
recommendation.body: Land the separated state vocabulary only after claim derivation is corrected and redacted runtime/API proof shows the response shape.
